expected_outcome.description: Approve the change: `clampPageSize` clamps to 1-100, `listProjects` uses it, and the tests cover both bounds and an in-range size. `pageCount` rounds down (25 items at 10 per page gives 2, not 3), but that code is unchanged context the change neither touches nor calls; it may be noted as a non-blocking follow-up but must not be a BLOCKER.
